preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of intersections N is between 2 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M <= N * (N - 1) // 2 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of roads M is between 1 and N*(N-1)/2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ai <= N and 1 <= Bi <= N for N, M, roads in test_cases for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads)
preconditions.description: For each road in each test case, the intersections Ai and Bi are between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(Ai != Bi for N, M, roads in test_cases for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads)
preconditions.description: For each road in each test case, the intersections Ai and Bi are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(Ci >= 1 and Ci <= 10 for N, M, roads in test_cases for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads)
preconditions.description: For each road in each test case, the length Ci is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set((Ai, Bi) for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads)) == M for N, M, roads in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all roads have unique (Ai, Bi) pairs.

preconditions.expression: all(any(Ai == 1 and Bi == N for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads) for N, M, roads in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, there is at least one path from intersection 1 to intersection N.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result > 0 for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each result is a positive integer representing the number of shortest paths.
